attacks.textKo: 이 포켓몬의 HP를 「10」회복한다.

flavorText: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.

name: Shaymin

attacks.name: Aromatherapy

attacks.textKo: 자신의 포켓몬 전원의 HP를 각각 「30」회복한다.

attacks.name: Magical Leaf
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage and heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.
attacks.textKo: 동전을 1번 던져서 앞면이 나오면 20데미지를 추가하고, 이 포켓몬의 HP를 「20」회복한다.

flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

name: Victini

attacks.name: Energy Assist
